args.query: SELECT s.store_id, s.name, c.customer_id FROM stores s LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.store_id=s.store_id WHERE s.name ILIKE '%rural%cycle%'

SELECT l.sku, sum(l.order_qty) q, count(*) n, min(o.order_date), max(o.order_date), string_agg(distinct o.customer_id::text, ',') FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE o.customer_id::text IN ('10','29770') AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT upper(trim(l.sku)) sku, o.status, sum(l.order_qty) q FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE o.customer_id::text IN ('10','29770') AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND upper(l.sku) LIKE '%BK%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY q DESC
SELECT product_number, name, make_flag FROM products WHERE upper(replace(product_number,' ','')) LIKE '%M68B-38%'

SELECT 'ip' t, product_number, list_price::text, null::text s, null::text e FROM item_prices WHERE product_number ILIKE '%M68B-38%' UNION ALL SELECT 'h', product_number, list_price::text, start_date::text, end_date::text FROM list_price_history WHERE product_number ILIKE '%M68B-38%'

SELECT work_order_id, part_no, order_qty, stocked_qty, scrapped_qty, start_date, end_date FROM work_orders WHERE upper(part_no) LIKE '%M68B-38%' AND end_date >= '2025-04-01' AND end_date < '2025-07-01'

SELECT part_no, count(*), sum(order_qty), sum(stocked_qty), sum(scrapped_qty) FROM work_orders WHERE upper(trim(part_no)) LIKE '%BK-M68B-38%' AND end_date >= '2025-04-01' AND end_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY part_no

WITH RECURSIVE t(n, lvl) AS (SELECT 'BK-M68B-38', 0 UNION SELECT b.component_number, t.lvl+1 FROM bom b JOIN t ON upper(trim(b.assembly_number))=upper(trim(t.n)) WHERE b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date='' ) SELECT t.n, t.lvl, p.make_flag, p.name FROM t LEFT JOIN products p ON upper(trim(p.product_number))=upper(trim(t.n))
SELECT end_date, count(*) FROM bom GROUP BY end_date ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT part_ref, vendor_id, average_lead_time FROM vendor_items ORDER BY average_lead_time DESC
